_comment: Seed for the hosted tastytrade worker (see RENDER.md). The worker copies this to $SPX_NOON_HOME/config.json once, only when that file is missing, and never overwrites it. There are no credentials here and none belong here: the five secrets are env vars pasted in the Render dashboard. There is no broker key - SPX_NOON_BROKER pins the broker - and no base_dir, so SPX_NOON_HOME (/data, the mounted disk) is the home directory.
_orders: mode live is what transmits; dry and alerts never send. tasty_orders sandbox sends to api.cert.tastyworks.com and the startup banner says REAL MONEY=NO. Real money needs tasty_data AND tasty_orders at production, and tasty_orders=production with sandbox data refuses to start.
_rules: Version B only. 15m closes 12:00-1:00 PM ET, first qualifying bar, 1 spread. Long nearest 75 delta. Width max(10, floor(EM/5)*5) where EM is the ATM straddle mid. Limit at mid. Skip if the marketable debit is more than $0.20 per side worse than mid. GTC close at debit x 1.30. Flat 2 hours after the entry bar. No stop.
_wrap: The worker runs python -m spx_noon wrap --now once at 16:20 ET. It does not connect and does not send orders; it writes reports/wrap-<date>.md from state/trades.csv.
